contract: The actual shared Android reader surface exposes indeterminate progress while page imagery is pending, including when the document page count is already known. Success and failure remove pending feedback.
credibleRegression: PDF and comic callers clear the bitmap before async rendering/loading while total remains positive; current ReaderPageView only shows progress for total zero.
primaryOwner: Extend ReaderAccessibilityTest, which already renders the real shared Compose view. ReaderApi tests cover response/security contracts but do not observe pending visual or progress semantics.
productionSeam: None. Direct shared UI rendering with existing pending/loaded/error props; no loading predicate or new injectable service.
failureModes: loaded image must have no spinner
failed page must have no spinner and keep polite error feedback
format unavailable must have no spinner
save failure must preserve loaded content
evidenceBoundary: Robolectric UI semantics and, if supported, rendered captures; separate from emulator, physical-device, network and PDF decoder evidence.
